intro: Lesson 22: Eating out and shopping: the role play. Read the Arabic aloud, then do the tasks. Write in Arabic with all the harakat.

head: Arabic
English
rows: I would like chicken with rice

arabic.text:
- أَهْلًا، مَاذَا تُرِيدُ أَنْ تَأْكُلَ؟
- هَلِ اللَّحْمُ حَلَالٌ؟
- نَعَمْ، كُلُّ اللَّحْمِ حَلَالٌ.
- أُرِيدُ كَبَابًا وَسَلَطَةً وَمَاءً.
- (!) مَاذَا أَكَلْتَ أَمْسِ؟
arabic.ref: Our own role play; (!) = unexpected question

questions.q: Answer the unexpected question: مَاذَا أَكَلْتَ أَمْسِ؟
questions.a: e.g. أَمْسِ أَكَلْتُ سَمَكًا مَعَ البَطَاطِسِ

questions.q: Two role plays (our own) in breakout pairs: restaurant and clothes shop, each with an unexpected question; then write the shop role play in the portal response box.
questions.a: Complete role plays with halal request, price, size and an answered unexpected question

questions.q: Extend: Group A (4AA1): write a three-sentence summary of your answer in other words and give the i'rab of one sentence. Group B (1AA0): say your answer aloud in a breakout and answer one follow-up question.
questions.a: Group A: accurate summary and i'rab; Group B: fluent spoken answer
A) الحِسَابُ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ. الحِسَاب = the bill.

questions.q: Think again: how can you be sure food is halal?
questions.a: Ask, check certification, or choose vegetarian or fish.
